dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer represents 7,400 Milwaukee Police Department reporting districts as accessed September 18, 2026. The source portal states that the dataset is updated as needed. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
